Trace, implement and test: Overriding1

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
class Fruit{
    String name = "Fruit";
    String taste = "Bland";
    String size = "Medium";

    void eat(){
        System.out.println(this.name + " tastes bland.");
    }
}

class Apple extends Fruit{
    String name = "Apple";

    void eat(){
        System.out.println(this.name + " tastes sweet.");
    }
}

class Orange extends Fruit{
    String name = "Orange";

    void eat(){
        System.out.println(this.name + " tastes sour.");
    }
}

class TestFruit{
    public static void main(String[] args){
        Fruit fr = new Fruit();
        fr.eat();
        Apple ap = new Apple();
        ap.eat();
        Orange or = new Orange();
        or.eat();
    }
}
